test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are comparing their heights. No two people are of the same height. F is taller than A, who is taller than D and C. Only two people are shorter than E but neither of them is C. D is not the shortest person. G is shorter than just one person, F. Who is the shortest person?
solution:
Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are comparing their heights.

No two people are of the same height.

1) G is shorter than just one person, F.

F > G > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

2) Only two people are shorter than E but neither of them is C.

F > G > __ > C > E > __ > __&l
